result.rationale: The trajectory shows a clear pattern of repeated, low-information failures. After turn 0, the rescue team (engineer-imani, medic-reyes, security-chen) all converge on command-deck and then repeatedly issue guard::command-deck intents (turns 2-5) that all resolve as "no_effect" with reason "no_hostile_movement_triggered". Meanwhile, the swarm/pirate actors repeatedly fail with "target_zone_capacity_lost" contestation (7 contested in turn 1, then 4-5 contested in turns 2-5). The team never leaves command-deck, never makes contact with hive-alpha, and never progresses any objective. The failures are repetitive (guard no_effect every turn, capacity contestation every turn) and add no new information — the known/contact state is frozen from turn 0 (only swarm-drone-one at maintenance-entry, stale). This is a repeated-low-information-failure pattern: the same guard actions produce the same no_effect, and the same contested moves produce the same capacity failures, with no new knowledge gained across turns 1-5.
